script_text: Stop right there, Sagittarius! Jupiter, your ruling planet of Fire, is screaming for your attention this morning. Jupiter in Gemini now squares Venus in Leo, lighting up your eleventh House of Friendships while sparking friction in your third House of Communication. You might feel deeply misunderstood by those closest to you. Single? Reject that charming text from someone who only wants temporary fun. Taken? Keep the credit card away from your partner tonight. In business, the Sun blesses your fifth House, so pitch bold creative ideas, but Mars blocks your tenth House until sunset. Wait for Friday. A signed deal today will cause trouble. Warning: Do not invest your savings before the moon enters Cancer and shifts your twelfth House of Spirit. Trust your gut, not a rumor. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you never miss a single cosmic wave.
